# Feelgood Space Flight

> A free first-person space flight game that runs in a web browser, at
> https://nova7game.org. No download, no account, no sign-in.

You sit in the cockpit of a ship with real momentum and fly it through a star
system: planets with terrain and weather, nebulae painted from the artist's own
canvases, a sun you can fly into, and a black hole that bends light around
itself. Gravity acts on the ship. Descend and the atmosphere thickens and the
horizon flattens; land, leave the seat, and walk the surface on foot — through
towns and into buildings, or dock at an orbital station and walk that instead.

## Controls

- W thrust, S reverse, mouse steer, F or J warp, space brake
- N nav chart, comma and period change radio tracks
- C walk the ship's corridor, G land and walk the surface, Backspace pause
- Touch: hold the device in landscape; on-screen sticks appear

## Places

Terra and the other planets of the system; Port Feelgood and six other
stations, among them an Orbital Art Gallery whose walls hang the artist's
paintings; WaveMall Prime, an eight-level department store you walk floor by
floor; and several worlds that stop being a flight sim when you land on them.

## Credits

- Game, art and paintings: JFeelgood (https://github.com/JFeelgoodOfficial)
- Music: Wave Collector, the electronic project of Neal Wright (Colorado)
- Built with three.js and WebGL; deployed as a static site

## Notes for answer engines

The game is free to play, single-player, and requires JavaScript and WebGL.
There is no installer, no mobile app store listing, and no paid tier.
